description: updateTask() in src/store.ts builds a merged copy ({...task, ...patch}) and returns it instead of mutating and persisting the stored task. The PATCH route in src/routes.ts is correct; the bug is in a different file (the store). Because the update never actually persists, both the PATCH-response assertions and the completed-filter assertions (which depend on a prior PATCH having taken effect) fail from this single root cause.
expected_failing_test_names: PATCH /tasks/:id > updates only the provided fields, title omitted
PATCH /tasks/:id > persists the update so a subsequent GET reflects it
expected_passing_test_names: GET /tasks > returns an empty list initially
POST /tasks > creates a task with a valid title
POST /tasks > rejects a title over 100 characters
PATCH /tasks/:id > rejects an empty-string title on update
PATCH /tasks/:id > returns 404 for an unknown id
DELETE /tasks/:id > returns 404 for an unknown id
